title: Share of Chargeable Wear Billed by Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier
content:
**Share billed.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, only part of the chargeable wear is billed for higher tiers with a good late-charge record:

- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 2, Tier 1 or Tier 1+ with at most one balloon late charge assessed in the 12 calendar months ending on the billing date is billed **0.5** (half) of the chargeable wear;
- a contract in Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 3 or Tier 4 with at most one balloon late charge in those months is billed **0.75** (three quarters) of it;
- every other contract, that is a Tier 5 contract or any contract with two or more late charges in those months, is billed the whole chargeable wear.

The share is taken of the chargeable wear and the result is rounded to the cent. The late charges counted are the balloon late charge entries dated within the window; a window of 12 calendar months ending on the billing date takes in the dates on or before the billing date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

## Share table

| Tier | 0 or 1 late charge in the 12 months | 2 or more |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1+, Tier 1, Tier 2 | 0.5 | Whole |
| Tier 3, Tier 4 | 0.75 | Whole |
| Tier 5 | Whole | Whole |

*Hypothetical:* a chargeable wear of USD 333.33 on a Tier 3 contract with no late charge: 0.75 of it is 249.9975, billed as USD 250.00.
